writer_blank_document.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is open with the standard menu bar, formatting toolbars, sidebar tabs, ruler, and status bar visible. The text cursor is in the empty page, ready for editing.

writer_file_menu_open.description: LibreOffice Writer is showing a blank document with the File menu expanded. The dropdown lists file operations like open, save, export, print, and properties while the main editing canvas remains visible behind it.

writer_open_file_dialog.description: A native Open file dialog is open on top of LibreOffice Writer, showing the /home/user1 directory contents and file selection controls. The underlying Writer window and toolbars remain visible but are blocked by the modal dialog.

writer_blank_document__2.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is visible with the standard menus, formatting toolbars, ruler, sidebar tabs, and status bar. No menu or dialog is open, and the page is ready for editing.

writer_blank_document__3.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is visible with menus, standard and formatting toolbars, ruler, right sidebar tabs, and status bar. No menu or dialog is open, and the text cursor is ready in the page.

writer_view_menu_open.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a blank document with the View menu expanded. The menu exposes display and panel options such as Sidebar, Styles, Navigator, Full Screen, and Zoom while the editing canvas remains visible behind it.

writer_blank_document__4.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is visible with the standard menu bar, toolbars, ruler, editing page, and status bar. No menu or dialog is open, and the cursor is ready for typing.

writer_blank_document__5.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is visible with the standard menu bar, toolbars, ruler, editing page, and status bar. No menu or dialog is open, and the insertion cursor is ready for typing.

writer_print_preview.description: LibreOffice Writer is in print preview mode, showing a single page preview with preview-specific zoom and layout controls. Most editing toolbar actions are disabled, and a prominent Close Preview button is available.

writer_blank_document__6.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is open with the standard menu bar, multiple formatting toolbars, ruler, editing page, and status bar visible. The insertion cursor is active near the top-left of the page, and no menu or dialog is open.

writer_format_menu_open.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a blank document with the Format menu expanded. The menu exposes text, paragraph, page, list, image, and object formatting commands while the editing canvas remains visible behind it.

writer_format_text_submenu_open.description: LibreOffice Writer is showing the Format menu with the Text submenu expanded. The submenu exposes character formatting actions like bold, italic, underline, case conversion, superscript, and size changes over the blank document.

writer_blank_document__7.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is visible with the standard menu bar, multiple toolbars, ruler, editing page, and status bar. No menu or dialog is open, and the insertion area is ready for editing.

writer_styles_menu_open.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a blank document with the Styles menu expanded. The dropdown lists paragraph, character, list, and style-management commands over the main editing window.

writer_paragraph_style_dialog.description: A modal paragraph style editing dialog for 'Default Paragraph Style' is open over the Writer document. It shows many style configuration tabs and action buttons like Apply, Cancel, and OK.

writer_blank_document__8.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is open with the standard menu bar, toolbars, rulers, editing page, and status bar visible. No menu or dialog is open, and the insertion cursor is ready for typing.

writer_blank_document__9.description: A blank LibreOffice Writer document is visible with the standard menu bar, multiple toolbars, ruler, editing page, and status bar. No menu or dialog is open, and the insertion cursor is active near the top-left of the page.

writer_table_menu_open.description: LibreOffice Writer is showing a blank document with the Table menu expanded. The menu exposes table-related commands such as insert, delete, select, size, convert, and formula editing, with many cell-specific actions disabled because no table is selected.

writer_insert_table_dialog.description: A modal Insert Table dialog is open over a blank Writer document. It lets the user name the table, choose rows and columns, set heading options, pick a table style, and either insert or cancel.

elements.name: Repeat heading rows on new pages

buttons: Repeat heading rows on new pages

writer_table_inserted.description: A Writer document now contains an inserted table, with the cursor active in cell A1. Standard menus and formatting toolbars remain visible, and table-specific context is reflected in the style dropdown and status bar.

writer_table_inserted_tools_menu_target.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document with a newly inserted table selected in cell A1. No menu or dialog is open, and table-specific toolbars and status indicators are visible.

writer_tools_menu_open_on_table.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document with an inserted table selected in cell A1 and the Tools menu expanded. The menu exposes proofreading, language, numbering, update, protection, and configuration commands over the main editing window.

writer_word_count_dialog_on_table.description: A small Word Count dialog is open over a Writer document containing a table. The dialog shows zero counts for selection and document and offers Help and Close buttons, while the underlying table-editing toolbars remain visible but blocked by the modal.

writer_table_inserted_cell_selected.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document with an inserted table and the cursor active in cell A1. Table-specific toolbars are visible, including row/column insertion, deletion, merge, border, and alignment controls.

elements.name: Text cursor in table cell A1

writer_table_inserted_cell_selected__2.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document with a 2-row, 2-column table inserted and the cursor active in cell A1. Table-specific toolbars are visible along with the standard menus, formatting controls, and status bar.

writer_insert_menu_open_on_table.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document with a table selected and the Insert menu expanded. The menu exposes many insertion commands for document content such as image, chart, section, comment, hyperlink, fields, and headers/footers.

writer_insert_image_file_dialog_on_table.description: A file picker dialog for inserting an image is open over a Writer document that contains a table. The dialog shows the home directory, file type filters for images, and Open/Cancel controls.

writer_table_inserted_cell_selected__3.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document with a 2x2 table inserted and the cursor active in cell A1. Table-specific toolbars are visible along with standard formatting controls and the status bar.

writer_table_inserted_form_toolbar.description: Writer shows a document with a 2x2 table and the cursor in cell A1. Table-specific toolbars are visible at the bottom, and no menu or dialog is open.

writer_tools_menu_open_on_table__2.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document containing a table with the Tools menu expanded. The menu exposes proofreading, numbering, update, protection, and configuration commands while the table remains visible behind it.

writer_accessibility_check_dialog_on_tab.description: A modal accessibility check dialog is open over a Writer document containing a table. The dialog reports that the document title is not set and offers Help, Cancel, and OK buttons.

writer_table_inserted_cell_selected__4.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document containing a table with the cursor in cell A1. Table-specific toolbars are visible at the top and bottom, and no menu or dialog is open.

writer_table_inserted_cell_selected__5.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document containing a 2x2 table with the cursor in cell A1. Standard formatting controls and extensive table-specific toolbars are visible, with no menu or dialog open.

writer_help_menu_open_on_table.description: LibreOffice Writer is showing a document with a table selected and the Help menu expanded. The menu contains help, feedback, safe mode, and about items while the table-editing toolbars remain visible behind it.

writer_help_not_installed_dialog_on_tabl.description: Writer is open with a table inserted in the document, and a modal help-related dialog is blocking interaction. The dialog says built-in help is not installed and offers Read Help Online or Cancel.

writer_table_inserted_cell_selected__7.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a blank document with a 2x2 table inserted and the cursor active in cell A1. Standard formatting controls and extensive table-specific toolbars are visible, with no menu or dialog open.

writer_insert_menu_open_on_table__2.description: LibreOffice Writer shows a document containing a table with the Insert menu expanded. The menu exposes many content insertion commands over the table-editing view and toolbars.

writer_bookmark_dialog_on_table.description: A modal Bookmark dialog is open over a Writer document containing a table. The dialog allows naming and inserting a bookmark and shows an empty bookmarks list, while the underlying document and toolbars are blocked.
